deficits.evidence: The footway is an informal path blocked by market stalls and goods.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a dedicated, unobstructed sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: Market stalls and produce carts completely block the pedestrian area.
deficits.suggestion: Relocate market stalls to a designated vending area to clear the pedestrian path.

deficits.evidence: Uneven pavement and debris are visible along the edge of the road.
deficits.suggestion: Repave the left-side sidewalk to remove uneven surfaces and trip hazards.

deficits.evidence: The informal path is uneven and cluttered with market equipment.
deficits.suggestion: Level the ground on the right side to provide a safe walking surface.

deficits.evidence: High pedestrian demand due to shops on both sides, but no designated crossing facility.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing to provide pedestrians with a safe place to cross the street.

deficits.evidence: No street lights are visible along this urban commercial stretch.
deficits.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety at night.

ratings.reason: The right side is clearly occupied by market stalls, leaving no formal footway, but the available space for a new one is unclear.
